message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to weather data, so I can’t give you the current conditions in San Francisco. However, here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect:

| Time of Year | Typical Temperature | Humidity | Cloud Cover | Rain Probability |
|--------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|------------------|
| **Winter** (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | 70–80 % | Mostly cloudy | 30–40 % |
| **Spring** (Mar–May) | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | 60–70 % | Partly cloudy | 20–30 % |
| **Summer** (Jun–Aug) | 57–68 °F (14–20 °C) | 50–60 % | Mostly sunny | <10 % |
| **Fall** (Sep–Nov) | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | 60–70 % | Partly cloudy | 20–30 % |

If you need the current forecast, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the typical climate or anything else!
